theorem_cxcvii: Every fundamental invariant of the optimal sphere packings in dimensions 4, 8, and 24 — kissing numbers, lattice dimensions, Coxeter numbers, Hermite constants, Lie algebra dimensions — is an integer polynomial in the W(3,3) atoms {Q,LAM,V,K,PHI3,PHI4,PHI6,J_INV,EDGES,EIG_MAX} with zero free parameters.
